name: Living Artwork
notes: The approved town square, blacksmith and inn use their exact original artwork with separate walkable geometry and depth layers. Building entrances and indoor services follow the artwork; displaced saved positions are repaired without changing items or progress. Removed promotional login slogans. Added native Exit controls to startup, character selection and Settings, using the acknowledged save-and-close flow. Other environments retain their existing art and are not covered by this visual acceptance.
